thread:
Riley: Heads up, PR #498 for the SDK snippets and migration guide is blocked. The docs preview shows contradictory examples for the sdk.generate call when max_tokens is omitted. Can @Priya or @Jon confirm runtime behavior?
Priya: Which example? The python snippet or the node one?
Riley: Both. In the python one I had `response = client.generate(model='r-instruct-1', input='long list', stream=False)` with no max_tokens and the note said server default 256. In the node example the comment said default 512.
Jon: Runtime canonical behavior changed last quarter. Non-streaming default is 256 now unless overridden per-customer. Streaming omitted still treated as unbounded (model limit applies).
Priya: Wait that contradicts what Ops told me last month. We need a reference.
Riley: The PR can't land until we have an explicit quoted source in the docs. The previews are failing linkcheck for a pointer to the internal ops runbook.
DocsBot: Preview build started for PR #498: https://preview.redwood/docs/498 - status: building.
Jon: I can add an inline quoted line: "As of 2025-02-10, non-streaming responses default to 256 tokens if max_tokens is omitted (unless customer-level override present). When stream=true and max_tokens is omitted, the server imposes no software default and responses are bounded only by the model token_limit."
Priya: That sounds right. Add a parenthetical about function_call interactions: "If function_call is used, the function return can terminate streaming earlier."
Riley: I replaced the conflicting comments in both snippets and added a migration note: "Previously docs used 512; updated to match runtime default 256 (see note)."
LinkCheckerBot: Linkcheck failed: 1 private link still present in footnote.
Riley: Doh. That footnote was for reviewers only. I'll remove it and replace with an internal reviewer-only comment in the PR.
DocsBot: New preview build queued.
LinkCheckerBot: Linkcheck passed. Preview: https://preview.redwood/docs/498 (green).
Priya: I can review final wording in 15m.
Jon: Approve from my side on accuracy.
Priya: LGTM.
Riley: Merging now. Thanks folks.
